sources.title: BPE (Byte Pair Encoding) | huggingface/tokenizers | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: BPE is a subword tokenization algorithm that iteratively merges the most frequent pairs of characters or character sequences to build a vocabulary of subword units. This model is used by popular architectures like GPT-2, RoBERTa, and Llama. For information about training a BPE model, see BPE Training.
